messages:
Priya (docs): Noticed a customer got 400 using the API ref example for POST /v1/models/deploy — example uses `replicas: 2` but runtime expects `replica_count` or `autoscale`. Can we patch docs ASAP?

Diego (eng): Confirmed. `replicas` was removed in controller v2. Runtime accepts `replica_count` (int) or an `autoscale` object. Also response example should be 201 with `deployment_id`, not `id`.

Lina (sdk): I left a deprecation shim in JS SDK that warns on `replicas` but docs should be updated to `replica_count`. I'll update the snippet examples in both SDKs once docs PR lands.

Priya (docs): I'll open a small docs PR to update OpenAPI, replace the request/response examples, and add a migration note. Draft curl snippet: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/models/deploy -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"gpt-medium-v2","replica_count":3}'`

Diego (eng): I'll add a quick compatibility mapper in controller to accept `replicas` -> `replica_count` and log a warning for one release; adding tests now.

Priya (docs): PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4335 — updates OpenAPI and adds migration blurb. Requesting Diego and Lina for review.

deploy-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4335 (merged by Diego)

Lina (sdk): Follow-up SDK PRs will reference the docs change and remove the temporary alias after next minor. I'll link them from the docs page once they're open.

Priya (docs): Action items: [x] update examples, [x] OpenAPI patch, [ ] add release-note migration blurb, [ ] coordinate SDK PRs. Closing after SDK PRs are linked.
